info.description: Sourced recall check from public United States recall records (CPSC products, NHTSA vehicles). GET /recall is paid per call: 0.05 USDC under the x402 exact scheme on Base mainnet, to the payout wallet named in the 402 response. Settlement runs through an x402 facilitator; a settled call returns the settle receipt in the X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Twenty five further endpoints wrap the other merged fetchers (/carrier, /litigation, /awards, /nonprofit, /formd, /pagespeed, /vin, /app, /fx, /safety, /meta, /epa, /trials, /csl, /drug, /links, /faa, /domain, /ofac, /github, /bank, /flood, /fda, /oig, /insider) with the same report contract; they are not yet behind the payment gate.
